ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent built on TigerGraph that breaks down multi-jurisdictional financial compliance queries, crawls vector databases and document stores, and verifies cross-border entity relationships to spot hidden legal discrepancies.
ideas.title: GraphRAG Multi-Hop Regulatory Compliance Investigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core hackathon theme of multi-step autonomous investigation and leverages TigerGraph's graph-native capabilities for complex traversal.

ideas.pitch: An agentic system that ingests supply chain unstructured invoices and shipment logs alongside vector chunks, mapping them onto a TigerGraph knowledge graph to recursively trace upstream failure impacts.
ideas.title: SupplyChainGraph: Autonomous Bottleneck and Risk Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering in combining graph traversal with recursive agent loops for real-world enterprise utility.

ideas.pitch: A medical RAG pipeline that splits complex patient inclusion criteria queries into sub-questions, querying both vector document snippets and TigerGraph relational treatment paths to evaluate clinical eligibility gaps.
ideas.title: ClinicalTrialGraph Agentic Cohort Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-stakes medical reasoning where simple vector retrieval fails and multi-step verification is strictly required.

ideas.pitch: An agentic system that constructs a complete dependency graph of a legacy repository in TigerGraph, iteratively investigates breaking changes across files using vector search, and plans safe multi-file refactors.
ideas.title: Codebase Archaeologist: Autonomous Legacy Refactoring Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a notoriously painful developer workflow by proving that agentic graph traversal outperforms shallow context windows.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous security operations agent that correlates unstructured threat intel reports with internal system telemetry graphs on TigerGraph to recursively trace lateral movement paths and isolate zero-day vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: CyberThreatGraph Autonomous Incident Horizon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live, high-impact demo showing real-time agentic reasoning over complex graph topologies rather than static RAG.
